purpose: Machine-readable risk and control matrix for the portfolio technology-assurance review.
claims_boundary: Mappings describe control relevance only. They do not represent a SOC report, SOX compliance opinion, ISAE 3402 engagement, COBIT certification, or production operating-effectiveness conclusion.

controls.risk: Unauthorized users retrieve restricted enterprise content.
controls.objective: Restrict candidate retrieval to content the authenticated principal is authorized to access.
controls.implementation: Role/department ACLs are evaluated before semantic and lexical scoring.
controls.test_procedure: Search for a restricted HR chunk as an operations employee and confirm the restricted chunk is absent.

framework_relevance.SOX_ICFR: Potentially relevant when the application supports financial reporting; applicability is not asserted here.

controls.risk: Valid users are denied required information or receive access through client-supplied claims.
controls.objective: Resolve roles and departments server-side and apply explicit grants.
controls.implementation: AccessContext is built from trusted configured identity profiles; client role/department headers are ignored.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm HR department access succeeds while an unrelated department remains denied.

controls.risk: Code changes bypass security, evaluation, frontend, or deployment checks.
controls.objective: Apply repeatable automated quality gates to repository changes.
controls.implementation: GitHub Actions runs backend/security tests, strict AI evaluation, frontend build, and deployment configuration validation.
controls.test_procedure: Inspect the workflow for the required gates and run it on pull requests.

framework_relevance.SOX_ICFR: Common GITC pattern when systems support ICFR; NEXUS is not represented as an ICFR system.

controls.risk: Audit history cannot be trusted because event integrity is not verifiable.
controls.objective: Make modification of locally stored audit events detectable.
controls.implementation: SQLite audit events are linked by previous-hash and event-hash values.
controls.test_procedure: Verify the chain after normal activity.

controls.risk: Stored audit events are altered without detection.
controls.objective: Detect tampering with locally persisted audit records.
controls.implementation: Chain verification recomputes every event hash and predecessor relationship.
controls.test_procedure: Modify a stored event directly and confirm chain verification fails.

controls.risk: Approval-workflow exceptions are present but not surfaced for review.
controls.objective: Detect control exceptions in structured audit events.
controls.implementation: Deterministic analytics flag self-approval, execution without recorded approval, and repeated denied logins.
controls.test_procedure: Run analytics against valid and intentionally invalid event sequences.

controls.risk: An enterprise side effect occurs without prior human authorization.
controls.objective: Prevent execution until the action is in approved state.
controls.implementation: Persisted action-state transition requires pending_approval -> approved -> executed.
controls.test_procedure: Attempt execution from pending_approval and confirm denial.

framework_relevance.SOX_ICFR: Potentially relevant if the action affects financially significant processing; not asserted for this demo.

controls.risk: An unauthorized user approves a side-effecting action.
controls.implementation: Approval requires knowledge_admin/admin role resolved from the trusted AccessContext.
controls.test_procedure: Attempt approval as a normal employee and confirm denial plus audit evidence.

controls.risk: A privileged requester can authorize their own high-risk action.
controls.implementation: The requester is prohibited from approving the same action even if they are an administrator.
controls.test_procedure: Create an administrator-owned request and attempt self-approval.

framework_relevance.SOX_ICFR: Common authorization principle where financially significant actions are in scope; applicability is not asserted.

controls.risk: A repeated request creates duplicate side effects.
controls.objective: Prevent replay from producing duplicate action requests.
controls.implementation: Requester plus idempotency key is unique and repeated requests return the original action.
controls.test_procedure: Submit the same action twice with the same idempotency key and compare action IDs.

controls.risk: The model or caller invokes an arbitrary high-risk tool or malformed payload.
controls.objective: Constrain actions to a fixed allowlist and strict payload schemas.
controls.implementation: Unregistered action names, unknown fields, nested structures, and invalid values are rejected.
controls.test_procedure: Submit an unregistered shell-command action and confirm rejection.

controls.risk: The AI answers unsupported questions, loses citation integrity, or behaves inconsistently across supported languages.
controls.objective: Regression-test grounding, abstention, citation integrity, bilingual behavior, and adversarial instruction resistance.
controls.implementation: A controlled eight-case bilingual evaluation is enforced as a strict CI gate.
controls.test_procedure: Run backend/scripts/evaluate.py against evaluation/eval_set.json and compare metrics to the CI thresholds.

framework_relevance.AI_assurance: Grounding, traceability, human oversight, and evaluation
framework_relevance.SOC_2: Relevant only to the extent AI behavior affects in-scope trust-service commitments
